title: Analcime zeolite synthesis from the bottom ash of co-incinerated industrial hazardous and medical waste for tetracycline removal from wastewater
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,27076-27083
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01328C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Anhong Li, Ping Li, Xiaolin Yue, Zehua Huang, Jing Zhang, Wenyuan Tan, Dong Yuan
Relatively pure analcime zeolite was synthesized from bottom ash of incinerated industrial hazardous and medical waste. It efficiently adsorbed tetracycline-containing sewage, achieving waste treatment with waste.
